professionalSummary.text: Defined the product strategy for the commercial lending portal and secured steering committee approval.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the 2024 product strategy paper for the portal and presented it to the digital steering committee, which approved it in February 2024.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed the backlog with the delivery team in two-week sprints.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Gathered requirements from relationship managers and credit officers.

skills.text: Coordinates user acceptance testing with lending operations.
